decision_basis: Owner direction: contributors permanently first; prospective students benefit from firsthand accounts and optional student connections. Folder name is historical, not a location restriction.

audience.segment: Prospective students and interested readers seeking firsthand Chinese-university experiences, regardless of location.
audience.need: Hear candid experiences from inside the university and connect with students where contact details are voluntarily shared.

objective: Bring relevant prospective students to explore university information and reviews.
offer_or_value: Candid accounts from happy, mixed, or frustrated students, with direct connections where reviewers choose to share contact details.
core_message: Hear from students at the university, including what they wish they had known before joining.

claims.wording: TRC focuses on Chinese university reviews for international students.
claims.limitations: Do not imply comprehensive review coverage or independent enrollment checks.

cta.text: Hear from students at the university
cta.network_and_device_notes: Check current review substance and voluntary contact availability for promoted schools. Do not promise a contact for every school/review, guaranteed replies, or information unavailable anywhere else.

distribution.community_permission: Unknown if community distribution is selected.

deliverables.variant_hypothesis: A practical checklist of details to investigate may attract people making a real study decision.
An accurate walkthrough of how to explore TRC may reduce uncertainty about its usefulness.

must_avoid: Claims all reviews are independently verified
Generated campus scenes presented as documentary evidence
Unrelated product sales in the same asset
Unsupported exclusivity claims about Reddit, Instagram, or YouTube

measurement.definition: Proposed definition: campaign arrivals that go on to view a university/review destination. Confirm measurement capability before adoption.
measurement.data_source: Confirm existing aggregate analytics and whether the proposed journey is observable.
secondary_metrics: Relevant outbound CTA clicks where measurable
quality_guardrails: No personal data in campaign parameters
measurement.attribution_method: Use non-sensitive campaign/creative labels if supported and approved. Report limits; clicks alone are not useful visits.

open_questions: Which countries, languages, and study stages are the first priority?
Which two channels can the owner sustain?
Which existing pages currently offer enough substance to promote?
Can existing analytics measure the proposed useful-visit definition?
